scope: Targeted correction verification before resuming large experiments; no external baseline or new physical navigation claim.

diagnosis.source_audit: all 300 original generated geometries, grouped by shader mode; source coordinate consistency and complete-input resampling error
diagnosis.branch_audit: 40 source-round-robin development inputs, three conditions; preserve raw/all-hidden, accepted, local/global and naturally absent denominators
diagnosis.parameter_controls: 20 development inputs x three conditions x four variants; distance/lengthscale relaxation not adopted because of regressions

data_correction.original_profile: legacy_v1: H in [1,1.6] for every mode; Swiss branch uses H as multiplicative gain
data_correction.corrected_profile: metric_v2: only Swiss gain sampled in [0.35,0.65], three fBm modes unchanged; no clipping or smoothing of exported geometry
data_correction.control: same seeds, windows, masks and noise, frozen old predictor on both geometry profiles; data correction must not be attributed to model improvement

method_correction.change: Convex-hull support of all measured XY; exact angular enclosure for local neighbors, not axis-wise bracketing
method_correction.unchanged: GP training/inducing budgets and kernel length, local nearest limit 0.35m, uncertainty gates, unknown completion off
method_correction.targeted_validation: 60 new corrected generated geometries plus 9 road inputs from 3 unused development-source groups and 11 indoor inputs from unused layout groups
checks: no accepted or locally completed exterior-hull query
risk confusion changes reported without deleting failures

limitations: The unsupported raw mean may still have large extrapolation error. Convex-hull support is not a physical passability guarantee, and sparse real references remain proxies. Old Swiss geometries remain a separate under-resolved pressure stratum, not deleted.
